criteria_verification.criterion_text: AC-5: Concurrent cancel requests are idempotent: a "cancel-in-flight"
criteria_verification.evidence: LifecycleBridge maintains an in-memory _cancel_in_flight: set[str] keyed by feature_id (rationale: registry-column variant would require a 3rd new file for the migration, exceeding the 2-file create budget; in-memory tracking is reset on detach/shutdown and the SDK side is itself idempotent against repeat cancel calls — same observable behaviour for AC-5). The flag is set BEFORE the await on runs.cancel so a concurrent second request that wins the race short-circuits via the cancel-in-flight branch (logs "reason=cancel-in-flight" at INFO and returns CancelResult(invoked=False, reason="already-cancelling")). Test TestRequestCancelIdempotent.test_concurrent_requests_call_sdk_once uses asyncio.gather + a sleeping fake SDK to race two requests and asserts len(runs.calls) == 1; test_second_request_is_no_op_after_first_returns covers the sequential case; test_sdk_failure_releases_cancel_in_flight_flag verifies the flag is released on SDK transport failure so the operator can retry.
